fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key property for categorizing masonry mortars, especially lightweight variants, and is explicitly stated in the dataset.

fields.name: compressive_strength
fields.rationale: Compressive strength is a critical performance metric for masonry mortars, indicating their load-bearing capacity, and is explicitly provided.
evidence: Compressive strength according to EN 1015-11: 5-10 N/mm2

fields.name: thermal_conductivity
fields.rationale: Thermal conductivity is important for assessing the insulation properties of masonry mortars, and specific values are given in the dataset.
evidence: Thermal conductivity according to EN 1745 lambda10,dry,mat / P=50 % ≤ 0.2 W/(mK)
Thermal conductivity according to EN 1745 lambda10,dry,mat / P=90 % ≤ 0.27 W/(mK)

fields.name: water_vapour_permeability
fields.rationale: Water vapour permeability affects the breathability of masonry mortars, which is crucial for moisture management in buildings.
evidence: Water vapour permeability according to EN 1015-19: 5/20

fields.name: production_method
fields.rationale: The production method (e.g., factory dry mortar, factory fresh mortar) influences the handling and application of the product, inferred from the description of manufacturing processes.
evidence: The mix is then packaged and delivered either as factory dry mortar in dry containers or silos or as factory fresh mortar ready-mixed with water.
inference_basis: Description of packaging and delivery methods suggests different production methods.
